WITH team_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    team_id, 
    SUM(w) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT year) as avg_wins,
    AVG(CAST(g - l AS FLOAT) / l) as avg_ratio
  FROM manager_half 
  WHERE l > 0
  GROUP BY team_id
),
mean_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as mean_avg_wins FROM team_stats
)
SELECT 
  ts.team_id,
  ts.avg_wins,
  ts.avg_ratio,
  ts.avg_wins - ms.mean_avg_wins as gap
FROM team_stats ts
CROSS JOIN mean_stats ms
WHERE ts.avg_wins > ms.mean_avg_wins
ORDER BY gap DESC
LIMIT 10    -- returns team_id, avg_wins per season, avg(g-l)/l ratio, and gap above mean; top 10 teams with above-average wins
